text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited at all times on the west side of Forty Third Street, between a point 78 metres north of Lake Shore Boulevard West and a point 30 metres further north, to improve visibility at the park access point.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Forty Third Street, between a point 78 metres north of Lake Shore Boulevard West and a point 30 metres further north.
